function.name: Level_ExitAndTerminalTransition
behavior: Checks PLAYER_WORLD_Y against the active level height and performs actor/resource cleanup for an out-of-bounds exit.
Consumes PLAYER_TERMINAL_TRANSITION as a delayed terminal/reload request and blocks the reset while PLAYER_INTERACTION_LOCK is active.
Clears actor records, reinitializes terminal actors, and restores the response state when the terminal path is accepted.
Reloads level behavior/resources, resets frame and terrain state, refills camera data, and runs the initial render/service sequence for a level change.
Dispatches the normal scene/resource transition path and returns to the gameplay frame pipeline after scene setup.

limitations: Ghidra currently represents the surrounding transition/service region as one large parent function; internal logical services remain tracked by their own entry points.
The level selector and several transition scratch fields remain mechanically named until their producer/consumer ownership is resolved.
conclusion: 0x001A8F0C is the boundary/terminal-transition coordinator, not a second scheduler. Its broad body contains the cleanup, reload, camera refill, and transition-to-frame-pipeline branches that are being split into named callees.
